title: The Company
subtitle: A party of two, online at once
description: A party size condition counts the members of the party who are online
right now, and a player on their own counts as a party of one -- so
`min: 2` is the bring-a-friend gate. The roster is not what is counted:
a party of three with two members offline is one person here, and that
is the number this condition means.
Nothing else about the quest changes. It is a checkmark, and the submit
is refused until somebody else is standing in the same party.
